Jules Park: Heads-up — ApertureLabs showing a sharp dip: WAU down ~65% WoW, active seats 15 -> 3. CRM notes: product lead replaced last week and a short POC with VendorZ started. Link: https://redwood.app/d/ApertureLabs/health
Renee Caldwell: yikes. Any infra flags or error spikes?
Hector Velez: infra clean. No error or latency regressions. Decline started 2026-05-14, aligns with VendorZ kickoff.
Sam Cho: risk triage = usage drop + PM handoff + competitor POC. Recommend rapid playbook: 1) 20-min discovery w/ new PM, 2) short ROI note + 1-pager migration friction, 3) offer 30-day seat buffer + 2 office hours.
Jules Park: please pull quick seat-level trend and recent token window. Hector?
Hector Velez: SQL for quick rollup:
```
SELECT date, count(distinct user_id) as active_seats, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage.events
WHERE org = 'aperturelabs' AND date >= current_date - interval '21 days'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date DESC;
```
Hector Velez: running now. No p95 shifts. Behavior change likely.
calendar-bot: Meeting created: "ApertureLabs: quick recovery sync" 2026-05-20 15:00 PT — invites: PM + Jules + Renee + Hector :calendar:
Renee Caldwell: Jules, can you draft a 3-line outreach + ask so PM knows it's low overhead?
Jules Park: draft: 1) short readout of what we observed, 2) ask about VendorZ pilot goals + blockers, 3) offer a 20-min hands-on session and 30-day seat buffer. Sending now.
Sam Cho: I'll draft a pricing/credit move: propose 45-day seat credit + 10% migration credit if they sign a 6-month commit within 60 days.
Hector Velez: I'll add infra/variant checks: model routing, KV cache hit rate, and verify no silent pool fallback.
Renee Caldwell: action items: A) outreach (Jules), B) pricing proposal (Sam), C) infra brief + runs (Hector), D) 1-pager ROI (Renee). Timeline: outreach today, infra brief by EOD tomorrow, pricing before meeting.
Jules Park: noted. Will ping PM and update here. :pray:
Sam Cho: keep high-touch for now — seems recoverable if we move quickly.
Jules Park: thumbs up. (reaction :eyes: 2991234690)
